title: Compatible flat tower diagram over a cochain arrow
statement: Let Y be a scheme and P,Pprime be cochain complexes of its module sheaves [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], each an actual flat telescope [def-sc-flat-telescope-stage-map], and f:P→Pprime a cochain map. There are three sequential towers E0,E1,E2 of bounded-above flat complexes and level maps a:E0→E1, b:E0→E2 whose sum maps commute with the one-minus-shift differentials. There are homotopy isomorphisms e1:q(Tel(E1))≅q(P), e2:q(Tel(E2))≅q(Pprime), an augmentation g:Tel(E0)→P, and quasi-isomorphisms qn:E0n→τ≤nP [def-pc-quasi-iso-modules]. The qn commute with the tower transitions after inclusion into P. The unshifted restriction of g is the sum of qn followed by those inclusions, and its shifted restriction is zero. In the homotopy category q(g)=q(Cone.map(a));e1 and q(g);q(f)=q(Cone.map(b));e2. No claim that g is a quasi-isomorphism, and no stage-map predicate, is included: these are verified from this data separately.

source.place: Parent lem-sc-flat-telescope-stage-map-refinement, step 1 and construction part of step 2; compatible-pair flat resolutions of Tags 06YS and 077J. The simultaneous maps to supplied telescope models are an agent expansion, not a literal assertion of these tags.

proof.text: Choose towers presenting P and Pprime. Resolve the arrow diagram over the good truncations of P using the bounded flat replacement and compatible successor construction, retaining both maps and the preceding stage in the state. Resolve compatible pairs at successor stages. Add mapping cylinders of transition homotopies to make transition squares strict; sums and split extensions preserve flatness and each stage remains bounded above.

Sort generators by finite support in the two original sum models and diagonalize the countable stages. Permit cofinal replacement of the two target towers instead of requiring a fixed original stage to contain every image. The resulting cofinal telescope presentations give homotopy isomorphisms e1,e2. The source truncation augmentations qn retain their quasi-isomorphisms and compatibility.

Take the sum squares and their explicit cone maps m1,m2. Define the canonical source augmentation g by the sum of qn followed by the truncation inclusions on the unshifted summand and zero on the shifted summand; compatibility proves it is a cochain map. The arrow homotopies retained in the construction give q(g)=q(m1);e1 and q(g);q(f)=q(m2);e2 in the homotopy category. Zero and identity arrows use zero and identical maps, respectively; the empty scheme uses the zero diagram.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_flat_telescope_arrow_diagram (Y : Scheme.{u})
    (P P' : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (hP : isFlatTelescope Y P) (hP' : isFlatTelescope Y P') (f : P ⟶ P') :
    let A := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)
    let Q := HomotopyCategory.quotient A (ComplexShape.up ℤ)
    ∃ (E₀ E₁ E₂ : ℕ → CochainComplex A ℤ)
      (t₀ : ∀ n : ℕ, E₀ n ⟶ E₀ (n + 1))
      (t₁ : ∀ n : ℕ, E₁ n ⟶ E₁ (n + 1))
      (t₂ : ∀ n : ℕ, E₂ n ⟶ E₂ (n + 1))
      (a : ∀ n : ℕ, E₀ n ⟶ E₁ n) (b : ∀ n : ℕ, E₀ n ⟶ E₂ n),
      (∀ n : ℕ, ∃ c : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, c < i → IsZero ((E₀ n).X i)) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (i : ℤ), SheafOfModules.IsFlat ((E₀ n).X i)) ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, ∃ c : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, c < i → IsZero ((E₁ n).X i)) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (i : ℤ), SheafOfModules.IsFlat ((E₁ n).X i)) ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, ∃ c : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, c < i → IsZero ((E₂ n).X i)) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (i : ℤ), SheafOfModules.IsFlat ((E₂ n).X i)) ∧
      ∃ (c₁ : flatTelescopeDifferential E₀ t₀ ≫ Limits.Sigma.map a =
          Limits.Sigma.map a ≫ flatTelescopeDifferential E₁ t₁)
        (c₂ : flatTelescopeDifferential E₀ t₀ ≫ Limits.Sigma.map b =
          Limits.Sigma.map b ≫ flatTelescopeDifferential E₂ t₂)
        (e₁ : Q.obj (CochainComplex.mappingCone (flatTelescopeDifferential E₁ t₁)) ≅
          Q.obj P)
        (e₂ : Q.obj (CochainComplex.mappingCone (flatTelescopeDifferential E₂ t₂)) ≅
          Q.obj P')
        (g : CochainComplex.mappingCone (flatTelescopeDifferential E₀ t₀) ⟶ P)
        (q : ∀ n : ℕ, E₀ n ⟶ P.truncLE (n : ℤ)),
        (∀ n : ℕ, QuasiIso (q n)) ∧
        (∀ n : ℕ, t₀ n ≫ q (n + 1) ≫ P.ιTruncLE ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) =
          q n ≫ P.ιTruncLE (n : ℤ)) ∧
        (CochainComplex.mappingCone.inr _ ≫ g =
          Sigma.desc (fun n : ℕ ↦ q n ≫ P.ιTruncLE (n : ℤ))) ∧
        ((CochainComplex.mappingCone.inl _).comp
          (CochainComplex.HomComplex.Cochain.ofHom g) (add_zero _) = 0) ∧
        (Q.map g = Q.map (CochainComplex.mappingCone.map
          (flatTelescopeDifferential E₀ t₀) (flatTelescopeDifferential E₁ t₁)
          (Limits.Sigma.map a) (Limits.Sigma.map a) c₁) ≫ e₁.hom) ∧
        (Q.map g ≫ Q.map f = Q.map (CochainComplex.mappingCone.map
          (flatTelescopeDifferential E₀ t₀) (flatTelescopeDifferential E₂ t₂)
          (Limits.Sigma.map b) (Limits.Sigma.map b) c₂) ≫ e₂.hom)
